across_options.issue: Beyond adding hairline card boundaries, the offer field expands horizontally from approximately x=194–827 to x=168–856 and extends lower. Its texture/color distribution also changes. This changes the area and expression of the field, an open D5 property, alongside D4.

The Nike content moves down approximately 6 source-image pixels and the lamp content approximately 13 pixels, while their action rows remain nearly level with the base. This changes internal photo-to-action spacing and row rhythm, not just the enclosing surface. The lamp card also leaves less white space above navigation.

The field mesh changes strength: lines are softer in the bubble option and markedly brighter and more conspicuous in the dot and corner-tag options. D5 owns texture strength; platform and state-marker comparisons do not hold it constant.

The bottom navigation shifts independently of the state marker. Relative to base, its top divider moves from roughly y=1378 to y=1375 in Dot and y=1371 in Corner tag; the icons, plus button and home indicator also shift. Coordinates refer to the supplied 1024×1536 boards.
